Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us).

Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.

The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.

• Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.

• Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.

• Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.

• Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.

• Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.

• Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.

• Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.

• Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.

• Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Successful candidates may come from leading universities, graduate programs, consulting firms, think tanks, policy research organizations, or technology companies. Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.

Specific qualifications include:

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Relevant fields include Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Law, or related disciplines.

• Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.

• Exceptional research, writing, and analytical skills are required.

• Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment.

• Familiarity with AI governance, technology regulation, or digital/cloud policy preferred.

• Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required

• Experience conducting quantitative or qualitative policy research.
